entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Diablo 3D candidate physical garment study based ONLY on attached private ICURS 150, item.design.base.cape. Reconstruct the actual source silhouette and colors, not generic equipment suggested by its name. Deep burgundy-red sleeveless cape, broad rounded shoulder curve with dark oval neck opening, two small dull silver-gray circular clasps near collar joined by short ochre link, deep vertical folds, flared scalloped lower edges and dull ochre/gold horizontal trim band near hem. No hood or sleeves. Keep muted red and heavy drape.
Create a clean realistic HD modeling sheet with EXACTLY FIVE separate depictions of ONE SAME garment: four LARGE complete separated views in a row labeled FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3-4, and a FIFTH smaller newly painted HD thumbnail beneath/right labeled ICON. Do not combine 3-4 and ICON. Fit whole object in each view. Charcoal background, neutral soft studio light, realistic restrained cloth/leather/material texture, no painted floor shadow. The object is displayed by invisible support, WITHOUT body, head, mannequin, hands, visible stand or character. FRONT follows the native garment; SIDE shows true depth, BACK rotates that same garment 180 degrees, preserves collar/closures/hem/holes, and uses minimal plausible unseen construction. The fifth thumbnail is independently rendered HD art of the same garment at inventory angle, NEVER pasted source pixels. No sprite inset, glow, scene, weapons or invented magical powers. No readable letters on garment. Hidden back, thickness, lining, seams and material readings are proposed inferences. Preserve same length, aperture positions, folds and accessories across views. Candidate only, not rigged or approved clothing.

reference.notes: Referência nativa 6x inspecionada antes da chamada. Fonte privada usada apenas para silhueta/cores; pixels não incorporados.

inferredAreas: Verso, espessura, construção e materiais propostos a partir de uma vista; não constituem geometria histórica recuperada.

coherenceReview.observed: Cinco vistas, capa burgundy, fechos circulares, faixa ocre e volume aberto preservados.
pendingIssues: Centros vermelhos dos fechos, elos quadrados e múltiplas linhas da barra são inferidos; confirmar sem assumir gemas.
SIDE/3-4 e queda das pontas exigem reconciliar abertura, comprimento e simulação flexível no rig existente.

entries.notes: Candidato sem aprovação. Thumbnail HD de estudo não é ícone runtime. Master/material, chão, rig/encaixe e legibilidade na grade lógica de 28px continuam pendentes.
